_notes.about: A sample of the release settings, for a Linux build machine building the PIC with XC16 alone. Copy it to tools/release.local.json (git ignores that one), or anywhere named by SMOL_RELEASE_SETTINGS, and fill in this machine's values. Keys starting with _ are not read. Only upload is needed: the tools find the rest in the usual places when a key is left out.
_notes.upload: user@host:/folder serving the release base URL. On rubidium the folder is the path inside the account's chroot.
_notes.ssh_port: The SSH port, 22 if left out.
_notes.ssh_key: The upload's private key: OpenSSH for sftp, a PuTTY .ppk for WinSCP. Left out, the agent (or Pageant). ~ is expanded. Keep keys in tools/keys/ (ignored by git) or outside the checkout.
_notes.upload_method: auto (WinSCP on Windows when installed, else sftp), winscp or sftp.
_notes.winscp: WinSCP.com, if not in its usual place (Windows only).
_notes.hostkey: The server's host key fingerprint, SHA256:... as ssh shows it on a first connection. Pinned for both methods; left out, sftp needs the server in known_hosts and WinSCP refuses.
_notes.arduino_cli: arduino-cli, if not on the PATH.
_notes.arduino_config: An arduino-cli configuration of its own (where its cores and toolchains live), if not arduino-cli's default.
_notes.esp32_core: The exact esp32 core version wanted. Left out, build_esp.py's CORE_VERSION is wanted, and another 3.3.x only warns.
_notes.pic_build: xc16 (tools/build_pic.py, XC16 alone) or mplabx (MPLAB X's Makefiles, the default).
_notes.xc16: XC16's folder (holding bin/), for pic_build xc16. Left out: /opt/microchip/xc16/v2.10, C:/Program Files/Microchip/xc16/v2.10.
_notes.dfp: The device family pack's folder (holding xc16/), for pic_build xc16. Left out: the newest under ~/.mchp_packs/Microchip/dsPIC33E-GM-GP-MC-GU-MU_DFP/.
_notes.mplabx: MPLAB X's folder, for pic_build mplabx. Left out: the newest under /opt/microchip/mplabx/ or C:/Program Files/Microchip/MPLABX/.
_notes.make: make, for pic_build mplabx. Left out: MPLAB X's own on Windows, the PATH's elsewhere.
